name: Lightning Flash
description: Forked lightning bolts crack down from the top of the frame, the screen flashes white in a few stuttering strobes, and the second clip appears lit by the last flickers as they fade out. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: bolts
params.description: Number of bolts: the main one strikes the ground, the others fork out higher in the sky

params.name: strike
params.description: Where the main bolt strikes, from the left (0) to the right (1) of the frame

params.name: seed
params.description: Changes the shape of the bolts

params.name: color
params.description: Color of the light, added to the clips

params.name: glow
params.description: Size and brightness of the glow around the bolts

params.name: flashes
params.description: Number of strobes; the clips switch during the brightest one
